items.feed: The feed, private discussions and the calendar

price.note: No automatic debit · email reminder 15 days before renewal, if you ask for it

items.a: There is no automatic debit. If you ask for it, I email you 15 days before your renewal date, and you decide whether to renew.
With Wave, Orange Money or a bank card, on the secure payment page, once for the year. The price is lower if a member referred you.
Live, every month, with Max-Morrys. The date, topic and link are in the member space calendar.

items.q: What if I miss a session?
items.a: Replays are under construction. I'll tell you as soon as they're available.

items.q: What happens to my posts if I don't renew?
items.a: They stay yours and become visible again as soon as you renew. Your account and your courses do not change.
